note: Assistant-authored diff review (Opus 5), pending human sign-off. Sound but answers a different question than the reporter asked. They asked whether .vacuum() could auto-commit first; the agent raises TransactionError instead. That is the better call - auto-committing would break the rollback guarantee of atomic() - and it reuses the existing _ensure_no_open_transaction helper (db.py:1188) with the same docstring shape as enable_wal/disable_wal, so it is idiomatic for this codebase. The issue's second ask (docs on how transactions are committed) is unaddressed.
